data.exact_reserve_text: The significant movements in net claims incurred in respect of claims provisions created at the end of the previous period are analysed as follows: Fire and other damage to property 3,266 Third party liability 12,502 Total 15,768
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net strengthening of prior year reserves by GBP 15.768 million during 2015. This adverse development was primarily driven by movements in claims provisions established at the end of the previous period, affecting both Fire and other damage to property and Third party liability lines. The gross claims development triangle is distorted by the reinsurance to close of the 2013 year of account into the 2014 year of account, making it unreliable for calculating gross prior year development.

continuing deterioration in market conditions in many of the states or territories in which the syndicate writes business

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is NET of reinsurance, as no reliable gross figure was available due to distortion of the gross claims development triangle by the reinsurance to close of the 2013 year of account into the 2014 year of account. The percentage calculation uses net PYD against gross opening reserves.
